answer.rationale: The scenario describes a contractor being selected to work in a covered PSM process area for the first time, which directly triggers OSHA's contractor provisions under 1910.119(h): evaluating contractor safety performance before selection, informing the contractor of process hazards, ensuring contract employees are trained on those hazards, maintaining a contractor injury/illness log, and developing safe work practices governing contractor entrance/exit/presence in process areas. These requirements are all explicitly supported by the scenario facts (contractor entering process area for first time, facing fire/explosion/toxic release hazards).
